name: NDW LoRaWAN meter fleet · Heltec WiFi LoRa 32 V3
description: Up to 200 simulated LoRaWAN water and electricity meters on one radio, with household daily patterns and occasional faults. For the Heltec WiFi LoRa 32 V3 only: its pins are that board's. The fleet is programmed over USB after flashing, from flash.meterfax.com.
$comment: chipMatch can only name the chip: esptool-js reports 'ESP32-S3', not the board around it. Any ESP32-S3 will be offered this image, and on anything but a Heltec V3 the radio and screen pins are wrong. The name and description carry the warning the regex cannot.
$comment2: An Arduino build, not ESP-IDF: boot-app0.bin is the Arduino core's otadata image, the same 8KB of 0xff the IDF builds call ota-data-initial.bin, and needed for the same reason — the console writes with eraseAll false.
